So the company was independent when the money was paid, and the record stands.

name: AXIS CORPORATION
acquired_date: announced 2024-06-07
notes: This one is close and worth reading carefully. Valence Industrial, which Blue Skies Operating Corp. owns, announced the purchase on its blog dated June 7, 2024, describing TruRebel as 'a family-owned and operated company'. An Internet Archive capture of axiscorporation.com from February 28, 2024 still read 'We are Family Owned and Operated Since 1958'. The FY2024 grant year ran July 1, 2023 to June 30, 2024, and the 25,000 dollar Inclusion Grant behind it was awarded in March 2021 when the company was family-owned, so the company was independent for all but the last few weeks of the payment year and the record stands. The conflict to know about: TruRebel's own history page says 'In 2023, Axis Corporation was acquired by Blue Skies Operating Corp.', which does not match the June 2024 announcement or the February 2024 website. I could not resolve the month, so a reader could argue the end of FY2024 was already under Blue Skies. Blue Skies is a small Midwestern group with about 79,000 square feet in Lexington, Kentucky and Sidney, Ohio, so even on that reading nothing material moves.
